svg.text: ETM nominal stress: tension peak vs cyclic DEL4 azimuth
4 historical ETM cases; 31 concrete gages; 16 azimuths; 600 s. No material fatigue inference.
(a) DEL4 loss if tension-peak direction is retained (%)
(b) Positive nominal peak missed by DEL4 direction (MPa)
124/124 pairs are opposite (180 deg); DEL4 difference at most 0.267%; hypothetical ±0.5% tolerance does not establish a winner.
